spell.mageadditions.piercing.guide: Imbue yourself with piercing magic for a duration. While active, projectiles you fire pass through creatures they hit and can continue into additional targets. Projectiles still collide with blocks normally.
spell.mageadditions.mirror_image.guide: Create physical copies of yourself at your position. Each copy receives its own permanent rotated direction, mirrors your movement input, equipment, pose and visible actions, uses normal block collision and gravity, and disappears in a poof when hit. Higher spell levels create more copies.
spell.mageadditions.capture.guide: Select an entity within 8 blocks and channel for 3 seconds to store it inside the spell. The selected target is outlined while the cast is locking on. Recast Capture to release the stored entity where you are looking, up to 8 blocks away. Non-player entities can be stored for up to 10 minutes. Captured players can rapidly press Space to struggle free early.
spell.mageadditions.capture.escape_info: Captured players can spam Space to escape early
message.mageadditions.capture.no_target: Capture requires an entity within 8 blocks.
message.mageadditions.capture.captured_p: You were captured! Spam Space to break free early.
message.mageadditions.capture.released_b: Released from Capture by the caster.
message.mageadditions.capture.already_ca: That entity is already stored in Capture.
message.mageadditions.capture.cannot_sto: That entity cannot be stored by Capture.
spell.mageadditions.mace_infusion.guide: Imbue yourself with mace magic for a duration. While active, non-mace melee weapons gain vanilla-style mace smash attacks when you strike after falling, including fall-based bonus damage and the smash knockback effect.
spell.mageadditions.earthen_step.guide: Teleport onto the surface of the block you are looking at. The departure point erupts with roots, rooting nearby living entities within 3 blocks for 1 second, while you are briefly rooted for 5 ticks at the destination.
message.mageadditions.minigame.final_sho: %s is the last team standing. Fight until one player remains!
spell.mageadditions.domain.guide: Channel for 2 seconds to seal the area around you. Every player caught inside is trapped until the timer expires or only one living participant remains. The Domain grants no combat advantage and cannot be crossed by movement, teleportation, projectiles or attacks.
spell.mageadditions.domain.rule: Ends when time expires or one participant remains
